summary: Phase F.0 (Multi-page Foundation per Blueprint Moodboard PRO™) — backend 19/19 PASS + regression 31/31 PASS (P0+E.5+E.2). 1 real bug found and fixed: POST /api/moodboards returned current_page_id=None because the response was the stale insert payload predating the UPDATE that sets current_page_id. Frontend live e2e on fixture moodboard 924f0e48 confirms PagesNavigator sidebar (180px @ x=220, left of 'AGGIUNGI BLOCCO' toolbar), 'PAGINE' eyebrow, add-page-btn → picker (ratio + type selects + confirm), card count 2→3 on add, and CANVAS RESIZES TO 1920x1080 when switching to a landscape_16_9 page (preset width/height honored). IT i18n present: 'Aggiungi pagina', 'Pagina senza titolo', 'Vuota', 'Mood'.
action_items: Bug FIXED by testing agent in /app/backend/routers/moodboards.py:create_moodboard — overlayed current_page_id onto the response (out = dict(r.data[0]); out['current_page_id'] = default_page_id). Main agent: please confirm this fix is acceptable; an alternative would be to re-SELECT the moodboard after the UPDATE so we get all canonical columns instead of patching the stale insert response. Currently the patch is sufficient and verified by test_new_moodboard_has_default_page_and_current_page_id.
critical_code_review_comments: moodboards_v1.PAGE_TYPES list matches spec exactly (13 types). ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS contains the 6 documented ratios with proper width/height + label_key registry — confirmed Blueprint-driven, frontend reads via GET /_meta/page_presets.
create_page auto-appends sort_order via max+1 SELECT (good). update_page recomputes width/height when aspect_ratio changes (verified PUT portrait_a4 → landscape_16_9 → 1920x1080).

duplicate_page implementation: clones the page row with sort_order+1, then SHIFTS later pages forward by +1, then clones every moodboard_element with new uuid + page_id=new — preserves layout. Verified by test_duplicate_page_clones_elements.
delete_page guard: 409 returned when len(all_pages) <= 1. Fallback for current_page_id is to the first remaining page (sort_order ASC). Both behaviors verified.
reorder_pages strictly validates set(body.page_ids) == existing_ids and returns 400 on mismatch — partial subset rejected. Verified.
Block create populates page_id from explicit body.page_id → moodboard.current_page_id → _ensure_default_page fallback. Verified both explicit and implicit paths.
Cross-tenant: studio2 GET /pages → 404 (filtered by tenant_id on the parent moodboard via _assert_moodboard). RBAC: client POST /pages → 403 via P_MOODBOARDS_WRITE decorator. Both verified.

BUG: moodboards.create_moodboard returned r.data[0] which predates the current_page_id UPDATE — fixed by overlaying current_page_id onto the dict response (out['current_page_id'] = default_page_id). All 19 F.0 tests now pass.
templates.apply_template creates default page + attaches cloned blocks with page_id populated — verified by test_template_apply_attaches_blocks_to_default_page (no unscoped elements after apply).

Backfill regression: existing fixture moodboard 924f0e48 has 1 default page + image element with page_id populated. All 37 existing moodboards covered by the migration 008 DO block per the original spec.

Frontend canvas size adapts dynamically — verified empirically: after clicking the new landscape_16_9 page card, canvas bounding_box became {width:1920, height:1080}, exactly matching ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS['landscape_16_9'].

rca of the issue: BUG #1 (FIXED): POST /api/moodboards returned current_page_id=None even though the page was correctly created and moodboards.current_page_id updated. RCA: the route INSERTs the moodboard (r.data[0] captured here, with current_page_id=None), THEN INSERTs the default page, THEN UPDATEs moodboards.current_page_id=default_page_id. Final response was `r.data[0]` (the stale pre-update payload) — the in-memory `moodboard` dict had the patch but was unused because `r.data` was truthy. Reproduction: `curl -X POST .../api/moodboards -d '{"title":"x"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'` → response.current_page_id == null. Mitigation: overlayed current_page_id onto the response dict before returning. Verified fix by re-running test_new_moodboard_has_default_page_and_current_page_id → PASS. No other bugs found.
